changelog:
v3.7.11 — Phone Touch Overhaul

The phone version of the app now works the way you'd expect a streaming app to work on a phone — Netflix-style gestures, modern bottom sheets, real touch feedback. Fire TV behavior is unchanged.

In the player:
• Double-tap LEFT half of the screen to skip back 10 seconds, RIGHT half to skip forward 10 seconds
• Slide your finger UP/DOWN on the LEFT half to adjust screen brightness, on the RIGHT half to adjust volume
• Press and hold anywhere = 2× fast-forward (release to return to normal speed) — only on movies and series
• Pinch to cycle aspect ratio (Fit / Fill / Stretch) — same effect as the Aspect button

Elsewhere:
• Search now opens the keyboard automatically when you tap the Search tab
• Tapping a movie or show poster's audio/subtitle button now opens a proper bottom sheet you can drag away — no more half-screen TV-style panel
• Long-press a poster brings up the Material info card with drag-to-dismiss
• Detail screens (movie / show pages) now have a back arrow at the top
• Hero carousel dots on Home are now tappable — jump straight to the title you want
• Action buttons in the player meet the 48dp touch-target standard so you don't miss them
• Cards across the app now show a touch ripple when you tap them

Nothing changed on Fire TV — every gesture above is phone-only.
